all.name: Aion

all.name: Exarch
all.note: Exarch (Major): buffs the HEAL TARGET (usually an ally) — team-side value outside the single-hero sim; self-heal uptime depends on heal cadence vs the 4s window

all.name: Weald
all.note: Weald (Major): execute-window true damage; the headline objectives evaluate full-health targets, so crediting it would overstate sustained output

all.name: Pilow
all.note: Pilow (Major): reduces ENEMY damage output within a radius; the sim models damage taken by one modeled defender, not a team-wide output debuff with uptime

all.name: Knell
all.note: Knell (Major): Only an explicitly supplied active-stack snapshot is modeled; omitted state receives no shred credit. matchups.gameplan: Your window is early: force trades before their core completes, and do not coin-flip fights past the crossover. Lt. Belica executes low targets with Neural Disruptor — don't linger below half HP.

counterSwap.line: Losing lane? Third item Raiment of Renewal instead of Magnify: their burst combo hits 13% less hard, and this kit gives up 9% of its damage for it.

matchups.gameplan: They out-threaten you whenever the lane is not even: treat this as a farm-and-team lane, not a duel. Gideon deals area damage — spread out so one cast can't catch the group.
